name: Text Converter

events.KeyPress:
# Update after Tk has inserted or deleted the typed character.
self.root.after_idle(lambda: text_update_stats(self))
events.FocusOut:
# Recount after paste operations and focus changes.
text_update_stats(self)

startup:
# Try typing or pasting your own text, then choose a conversion.
self.InputText.insert("1.0", "Hello world\nCreate something useful")
text_update_stats(self)
self.Form1.deiconify()
